name: year
description: Fall year of the school year the record refers to (2020 denotes school year 2020-21)

name: agency_id
description: NCES local education agency (school district) identification number, or LEAID (7 characters: 2-digit state FIPS followed by a 5-digit agency number)
observations: Zero-padded to 7 characters on load; the source strips leading zeros in the enrollment extracts.

name: state_id
description: State FIPS code as reported by the CCD
observations: Zero-padded to 2 characters. The CCD extends the state FIPS list with codes for jurisdictions that are not states (58 Department of Defense schools overseas, 59 Bureau of Indian Education, 61 and 63 Department of Defense domestic and overseas areas), so this column is not a strict foreign key into the state directory.

name: staff_category
description: Staff category the full-time equivalent count refers to
observations: Reshaped from the wide staff columns of the CCD agency universe file. Totals (teachers_total, guidance_counselors_total, lea_staff_total, school_staff_total, staff_total) are reported alongside their components and must not be summed together with them.

name: staff_fte
description: Full-time equivalent staff in the category
